rows.ARS:
White, near white or white blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: White Christmas
rows.Origin:
Bred by Howard & Smith (United States, before 1950).
Introduced in United States by Howard & Smith in 1953 as 'White Christmas'.
Introduced by Unknown (Australia) in 1962 as 'White Christmas'.
rows.Bloom: White. Moderate fragrance. Medium, double (17-25 petals), high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Long, pointed buds.
rows.Habit:
Upright. Light green, leathery foliage.

Height: 30" to 4'7" (75 to 140cm). Width: 2' (60cm).
